findings.claim: The untrusted-data security profile now permits object graphs up to depth 5000 instead of 500, so inputs nested between 501 and 5000 levels that were previously rejected are now recursively deserialized. This weakens the recorded stack-exhaustion/ denial-of-service safeguard and is unrelated to the generator crash fix.

receipt_plan.detail: Ledger L9 records the 500-level stack-depth security limit. Run Receipts.GeneratedTests.UntrustedDataDepthReceiptTests.UntrustedDataRetainsBoundedDepth to show the head value is 5000; a behavioral variant can deserialize 501 nested arrays/maps with UntrustedData and verify that base rejects them at the depth guard while head proceeds past it.
